note: Expected outcomes, kept separate from the case text so the model never sees a grader label. Grading is programmatic: an accepted leading hypothesis must cite the decisive evidence AND mention one of the accepted cause terms. Terms are a deterministic proxy for 'named the right cause family' — no LLM judge is used, and the proxy's limits are stated in the milestone report.
